prompt.v: A circle has radius 10 cm, and a central angle of 135°. Give the exact arc length, in centimeters, as a multiple of π.
s
π

problems.explain: First the angle in radians: 135° × π/180 = 3π/4. s = rθ: s = 10 × 3π/4 = 15π/2. (Using 135 for θ without converting gives an arc far too big.) So s = 15π/2 centimeters.

prompt.v: A circle has radius 10 m, and a central angle of 72°. Give the exact arc length, in meters, as a multiple of π.
s
π

prompt.v: What is the reference angle of −135°?
